scope: Offline research validation only; does not authorize deployment
implemented: LAN-driven stock iBlack to OpenIPC hi3518ev100-nor-lite-split migration that keeps the stock U-Boot 2010.06 and its env: host state machine (diagnose, probe, trial, final, restore), server, camera stage2 (phase1/phase2), hook, installer, one-shot self-reverting trial boot

replaces.reason: Wi-Fi-only camera without UART: an OpenIPC U-Boot that never booted on this board is not written

bugs_found_and_fixed: stock U-Boot 2010.06 _do_setenv leaves bytes behind the env terminator; om_stockboot.sh read them as live variables and took a restored env for the trial env. Parsing now stops at the terminator

stock BusyBox 1.18.4 dd accepts only if/of/bs/count/skip/seek (conv=, ibs=, obs=, iflag=, oflag= exit 1): trial.sh never wrote its tl log and could not restore the stock env after a failed saveenv. Fixed with a host-built tl template overlaid via 1<> and whole-partition writes
stock BusyBox 1.18.4 grep has no -x: trial.sh's manifest check always reported host=fail, which blocks final. Fixed with an anchored grep -q

stock BusyBox 1.18.4 wget sends --post-data form-escaped (%XX for every byte outside A-Za-z0-9 and !&'()*-.=_~): serve_migration.py stored the trial log as received and build_stockboot.py collect could not read a single flag, which blocks final. serve_migration.py now decodes that form. The builder and the x86 E2E dd/grep/wget behave like the stock applets; the qemu run probes the stock dd, grep and wget --post-data and the option parsing of the stubbed or blocked udhcpc, wget and mount
serve_migration.py replied to a refused upload without reading its body; the reset connection could hide the status (a flaky x86 test). Refused bodies are now read and dropped up to 1 MiB first
validator children (tests, server, qemu-arm) and temp dirs survived SIGTERM
three validator-side mistakes (runapp match string, missing stock readlink, host timing threshold)
inherited: OpenIPC wget --post-file stops at the first NUL (mdat sent base64); stock sh has no $((...))
hardening: diagnose refuses when 16 reads of the weak block (0x6c4f28) differ
trial and final envs must not carry a uImage magic at 0x050000 (OpenIPC split-layout probe)
trial.sh reboots at once when migrate.conf is missing instead of ending its shell
